name: Virtual Fighting Championship (VFC) 2
summary:
Step into the fight—literally.
Sequel to the VR OG fighting game VFC, VFC2 is a full-body virtual reality fighting game where you are the controller. Punch, dodge, and gesture your way through intense PvE and PvP battles, performing real movements to unleash shockwaves, fireballs, and devastating ultimate attacks—just like in Street Fighter™ or Dragon Ball™.



Game Modes:

- Single Player Campaign: Take on a variety of enemies and challenges as you fight your way through a story-driven journey.
- PvP Battl
